snippet.title: Playtiles Season 2: Weeks 1 to 3 Games
snippet.description:
In this video, we’re showcasing all the games released from Week 1 to Week 3 of Season 2.

Games featured:
#1 The Echoes of Worlds by TeamCalamar
#2 Pitchfork [Playtiles Edition] by JAIWare
#3 PocketWare 2 [Playtiles Exclusive] by Lavallure
#4 Bubble Frog DX by Timbo Jay
#5 Wink and the Broken Robot [Playtiles Edition] by Max Oakland
#6 Sword of the Apocalypse Ep. 4 [Playtiles Exclusive] by Gunsavior Games

All games are playable through the Playtiles system, designed to turn your smartphone into a physical handheld. 
All-in-one controller + App (PlaytilesOS) + 24-game bundle.

Playtiles Season 2 is available now, shipping worldwide (€35): https://get.playtil.es
